name: Open book
summary: Lying on your side with knees bent, open the top arm across to the other side like a book.
setup: Lie on one side, knees bent to 90°, arms stacked in front. Keeping the knees together, lift the top arm and sweep it across to the floor behind you, turning the head to follow. Return.
why: The rotation happens in the plane facing the phone only from above; from the floor the arm sweeps toward and away. Logged by hand.
tempo: Open 3 s, hold 2 s, close 3 s.
progression: Hold the open position longer; hold a light weight.
regression: Sweep only as far as the knees stay down.
contraindications: Pain in the shoulder on the sweep.

faults.label: Top knee lifting
faults.tip: If the knees separate, the movement is coming from the lower back instead of the mid-back.

faults.label: Hips rolling with the chest
faults.tip: If the top knee lifts, the rotation has left the mid-back and gone to the lower back.

faults.label: Leading with the arm
faults.cue: Turn the chest, not the arm
faults.tip: The arm follows the chest; it does not drag it.

faults.label: Holding the breath
faults.tip: A long breath out at the end of the turn gains a few more degrees for free.

guide.surface: A mat; a pillow under the head.
guide.cannotSee: The sweep — it moves toward the phone.

points.t: Rotates open; arm and head follow.
